add_sources.note: About page: Associação Cultural Plutão Camaleão, founded early 2017 in Ponta Delgada by Lovers & Lollypops, curator António Pedro Lopes and YUZIN-Agenda Cultural; has run 12 Tremor editions.
FAQ lists info@tremor-pdl.com (general), tremorpress@gmail.com (press) and bookings@grupoanc.pt.

Partners page (read Oct 2026, year not stated, taken as the 2026 edition): Financiamento Governo dos Açores, CM Ponta Delgada, CM Ribeira Grande, Certificado Açores, República Portuguesa + DGArtes, Lagoa; Patrocinadores FLAD, Grupo Bensaude, Wayzor, Bentrans, Azores Easy Rent; Mecenas Novo Banco dos Açores (Som Sim Zero) and A.C. Cymbron (Rabo de Peixe music school residency); Parceiros mediáticos Antena 3, RTP Açores, Antena 1 Açores, RTP; Apoios include NOS, Holy Cow, Neat Hotel, Bensaude Hotéis, Sociedade Ponto Verde, Ocean Pellets, Turismo de Portugal, Lovers & Lollypops; creative partners include Arquipélago, Coliseu Micaelense, APF.
Jun 2026 giveaway 'Tremor x Bensaude Hotels x Wayzor Rent a Car': 2 passes, 2 nights at NEAT Hotel Avenida and 25% off car hire for the 2027 edition.
Plutão Camaleão and APF-Açores run the #TremorSeguro safety and inclusion point at the festival.
Partner giveaway with hotel and car-hire sponsors.
7 Sep 2026: Tremor 2027 general passes sold out; first tier sold out in under 24 hours (4 Apr 2026 post).

notes: Organiser is Plutão Camaleão (Lovers & Lollypops, António Pedro Lopes, YUZIN). Large mixed roster: regional government funding, Bensaude group and car-hire sponsors, Novo Banco dos Açores as patron, NOS and Holy Cow as supporters. 2027 general passes sold out by Sep 2026, so demand is strong.
